types.patternErrorMessage: Table must be in the format: <database>.<schema>.<table>. Use square brackets for names with dots (e.g., db.[schema.name].table)

metadata.label: CDC Service
metadata.description: Handles SQL Server change-data-capture events (row reads, inserts, updates, deletes) delivered by the attached MSSQL CDC listener.

serviceTypes.name: cdc:Service
serviceTypes.description: A CDC service is a distinct service object that defines remote methods to handle database change events. Handler methods (onRead/onCreate/onUpdate/onDelete/onError) are recognised by convention, not declared on the type.
